description: This file defines and registers native Telegram commands for a bot, including command parsing, authorization, message handling, and reply dispatching. It integrates with the openclaw plugin SDK and manages command execution flow, permissions, and message lifecycle.

methods.name: loadTelegramNativeCommandDeliveryRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the delivery runtime module for Telegram native commands, with caching.

methods.name: loadTelegramNativeCommandRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the main runtime module for Telegram native commands, with caching.

methods.name: resolveTelegramProgressPlaceholder
methods.description: Extracts the progress message placeholder text from command native progress messages.

methods.name: resolveTelegramNativeReplyChannelData
methods.description: Retrieves Telegram-specific reply channel data from a reply payload.

methods.name: isEditableTelegramProgressResult
methods.description: Determines if a reply payload's progress message can be edited.

methods.name: cleanupTelegramProgressPlaceholder
methods.description: Deletes a progress message in Telegram if a message ID is provided.

methods.name: buildTelegramNativeCommandCallbackData
methods.description: Constructs callback data string for native command buttons.

methods.name: parseTelegramNativeCommandCallbackData
methods.description: Parses callback data string to extract command text if it matches the native command prefix.

methods.name: resolveTelegramCommandAuth
methods.description: Performs authorization checks for a Telegram command, considering group, topic, and user permissions.

methods.name: registerTelegramNativeCommands
methods.description: Main function to register and handle native Telegram commands, including setup of command handlers, permission checks, message lifecycle, and reply dispatching.
